item.title: Easter Basket Pop Up Easel Fold Card - Stampin' Up! Demonstrator: Tami White | Stamping, Crafting, & Card-Making
item.description: I took the pieces from the Celebrating Spring Paper Pumpkin Kit and turned them into a gorgeous Easel Card complete with a basket that practically pops off the table! I used the Subtles color collection for a soft spring vibe, colored the eggs with Stampin' Blends Markers, and even have a sneaky hack for making Easter egg shapes with the Woolly Friends Punch. Whether you're making it for Easter, Mother's Day, or just a cheerful "thinking of you," this card is as fun to make as it is to give!
